name: Hotel Le Lotus Grand

description:
[VERIFY] Candidate found in public map data (OpenStreetMap) and web listings on 2026-11-20. It sits by the Bhullanpur flyover, on the stadium side of the city, and could suit match visitors who want a shorter drive to Ganjari. Nothing here is confirmed yet.

[VERIFY] Call and confirm: the hotel is open and the name is right; the exact address and pincode; the phone number; the rough room price range per night; check-in and check-out times; whether it takes foreign guests; and whether it will take bookings for match days.
